hamilton-2015-nelson-chart.citation: Hamilton, Donohue, Hall, Leben, Quian, Sheinbaum and Watts (2015), Observations and Dynamics of the Loop Current, BOEM2015-006, February2015.
hamilton-2015-nelson-chart.access: Original BOEM report SHA-verified. Figure 5.2-6(p), printed page 253 / PDF page 283, the extracted original 1092 × 898 chart, and Table 5.2-2, printed page 255 / PDF page 285, were visually reviewed. The chart explicitly labels Nelson. The mixed solid/dashed frontal-analysis extent is read manually; inner drifter tracks are excluded. Original raster, placement, published axes and chart-data week were verified on one idle local CPU.

records.period_label: EddyWatch chart data: 26 August–1 September 1989. Report separation and registry initial separation remain separate.
records.case_label: Nelson explicitly named historical frontal-analysis chart; physical identity unverified
records.source_locator: BOEM 2015-006, Figure 5.2-6(p), printed page 253 / PDF page 283. Table 5.2-2, printed page 255 / PDF page 285, gives the chart-data range of 26 August–1 September 1989. The original embedded chart explicitly labels Nelson Eddy.
records.definition: Geographic east–west bounding span of the manually read outer Nelson frontal-analysis envelope, including the original dashed western front and excluding inner drifter tracks and the separate Loop Current.
records.scope: Historical source-chart frontal-analysis extent, not a verified full physical eddy boundary. No principal width, diameter, radius or area inferred.
records.qualification: The mixed solid/dashed original front is read manually. Dashed segments are not repaired and no closed topology is inferred. Six native pixels per extremum and outward rounding to 25 km describe reading sensitivity only. Frontal-analysis error, line interpretation, scan/axis distortion and physical uncertainty remain unquantified. The chart-data week is not an exact simultaneous observation. Report separation on 1 September 1989 and registry initial separation on 24 February 1989 remain unreconciled. Inner drifter tracks, the separate Loop Current front and local ADCP current phases do not supply these bounds. No footprint, state containment, ranking, annual range or seasonal playback is inferred.
